name: 大唐双龙 (DaTangShuangLong)
english_name: Twin Dragons of the Tang Dynasty (DaTangShuangLong)
english_description: Another independent implementation in this project's "Twin Dragons of the Tang Dynasty" family (alongside dtsl and dtslmud), based on Huang Yi's novel and set amid the chaos of the early Tang jianghu. Shares some base items and Chinese-name validation logic with its siblings but is built on its own codebase; new characters start at the Great Tang Academy and the Stone Dragon Martial Hall, a beginner hub offering banking, apprenticeship, and NPC sparring.
